resenas.texto: Very professional service and would remind to anyone who needs quick pest removal and follow up. We have a rodent problem at the house and they came it and cleaned it all up in a day!
Friendly, professional and on time. William did a small job at my place to take care of a few wasp nests but got it done quickly.

I am so grateful for Safe Space. I called that morning and by that afternoon William was here sealing cracks, gaps, walls and securing my sanity. His prices were exceptionally reasonable. I highly recommend Safe Space for any pest/animal issue. Thank you William!!!
